Fuel8
Paid acquisition plan by Bruno C. · Nov 2026 to Jan 2027

Performance led by return · Awareness always on

Performance pays. Awareness keeps people searching.

At US$3.00 a month, a subscriber pays back about $15.30 in their first year. Performance only buys subscribers that return at least 1.15 times their cost. Its margin funds an always-on awareness machine on Meta and YouTube. US, UK, Canada and Australia. iPhone only.

~510 Paying subscribers a month, at most
1.60 Performance return in year one

The maths sets the budget.

The price stays at US$3.00 a month, so the cap comes from what a subscriber pays back in their first year, plus a small margin.

$2.55 A month, after Apple's 15%
$15.30 First-year value · about 6 paid months
1.15 Minimum return · just above break-even
$13 cap Per paying subscriber · paid back in month 5
Each line is judged on its own. A blended average can hide a line that loses money, so every keyword group, creator and campaign has to clear $13 by itself.

Who does what.

Apple Search Ads leads performance. Creators and referrals are paid only when someone subscribes. Meta and YouTube carry awareness.

Performance · ~55%

Apple Search Ads

People searching the App Store for exactly what Fuel8 does.

  • “Fuel8” searches and narrow exact match, such as “offline calorie tracker” and “macro tracker no ads”
  • UK, Canada and Australia first: 20 to 40% cheaper than the US
  • Custom product pages matched to each keyword group

Bid rule: max cost per tap = $13 × tap-to-install × install-to-paid. At 60% and 10%, that is $0.78.

Performance · ~35%

Creators

Micro-creators in natural bodybuilding, powerlifting and digital privacy, paid for results, not for posts.

  • $8 to 10 per paying subscriber through their own code or link
  • A free year of Founders Entry instead of a flat fee
  • Their best posts become awareness ads on Meta
Performance · ~10%

Referrals

Founders invite friends, and both get a month free. It costs about $5 in revenue and no media.

  • Prompt after the first full week logged, never during logging
  • The friend keeps the $3.00 Founders price for life
  • Needs an App Store offer code system before launch
Meta and YouTube · awareness only Reels, Stories, Shorts and in-stream, bought on reach and views. Targets: CPM ≤ $10, cost per view ≤ $0.03, hook rate ≥ 30%, 2 to 4 views a week. Success is more searches for “Fuel8” than in the Canada holdout.
Not funded at $3 a month Meta subscription ads, Google Search and App campaigns, and broad or competitor App Store keywords. None returns 1.15 at this price.

Two budgets that work. One that doesn't.

Performance is capped by what clears the gate, not by ambition. More spend beyond the ceiling only buys subscribers that lose money.

The extra spend buys subscribers at $24–28, well above the $13 cap.

Blue bars are performance and grey bars are awareness. Bar length compares spend across all three budgets. Creator and referral amounts are only spent when someone subscribes. All figures assume about 6 paid months per subscriber in year one.

At $3 a month, growth compounds rather than spends. Once there is a user base, in-app notifications work it at no ad cost: useful prompts like a weekly progress summary, a new recipe or an invite-a-friend moment, never guilt. If subscribers pay for 8 months instead of 6, each is worth about $20 in year one, the cap rises from $13 to about $17.70, and more lines clear the gate. The same base brings more referrals, the cheapest line in the plan.

How budget moves.

The gate Any line below a 1.15 return after 30 subscribers: lower its bid 20%, then pause it if it stays there.
Prove conversion After four weeks, keep “Fuel8” searches only if 10% of installs pay, and narrow searches only if 13% do.
Step up Every line at 1.15 or better for four weeks, with room left in keywords and creators: move to $12,000.
Margin funds awareness Awareness spend never exceeds last month's performance margin. If performance earns less, awareness shrinks with it.
Prove awareness works Hold Canada out for eight weeks. No lift in “Fuel8” searches or organic installs: halve awareness.
Measure quietly Apple's own attribution, offer codes for creators and referrals, and server-side subscription events. No tracking SDK in the app.
